summary: Use Node runtime fallback for CommonJS require of a synchronously evaluable ESM graph.

target.notes: On supporting Node versions, require can load synchronous ESM and normally returns a module namespace object, subject to current Node interop rules.

caveats: This behavior changed across Node versions; specialize only against a pinned compatibility profile.
Current Node can customize require(esm) return via an export named module.exports.

tests.name: sync esm namespace
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export const x=1
// main.cjs: const ns=require('./a.mjs'); console.log(ns.x);

tests.name: default is namespace property by default
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export default 5
// main.cjs: const ns=require('./a.mjs'); console.log(ns.default);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 5 on supporting Node versions unless module.exports interop export customizes the return
